qa.topFinding: 83 integration tests across 5 suites (structure, frontmatter, manifest schema, mirror parity, version consistency), all passing. Tests validate plugin integrity end-to-end. However, tests are shell-based and do not test runtime behavior (no fixture project, no sweeper execution tests).
qa.recommendation: Add a fixture Vue+FastAPI micro-project in tests/fixtures/ and test manifest-generator output against expected manifest structure. This would validate the core runtime logic, not just static file structure.
qa.riskIfIgnored: Current tests catch structural regressions but not logic bugs in manifest parsing, risk scoring, or finding generation. A broken sweeper agent would pass all existing tests.

security.topFinding: No hardcoded secrets. Sandbox mode has proper pre-flight checks (APP_ENV, DB name, base URL). Risk scoring prevents destructive actions in production. Credentials sourced from manifest at runtime. .gitignore excludes sentinel-manifest.json.
security.recommendation: Add a security note in README about sentinel-manifest.json containing plain-text test credentials. Consider documenting that the manifest should never be committed to version control.
security.riskIfIgnored: Test credentials in sentinel-manifest.json could be accidentally committed to a public repo if users override .gitignore or copy the manifest elsewhere.

devops.topFinding: GitHub Actions CI pipeline added with 4 validation steps: JSON validation, plugin mirror parity, YAML frontmatter validation, and version consistency checks. All checks pass. CI runs on push to main and on PRs.
devops.recommendation: Add a test execution step to the CI workflow that runs tests/run-all.sh. Currently CI duplicates some test logic inline rather than invoking the test suite. Consolidating prevents drift between CI checks and local tests.
devops.riskIfIgnored: CI and local tests could diverge — a check could pass locally but not in CI or vice versa. Minor risk since both currently validate the same things.

development.topFinding: Skill and command are now in sync — both have --dry-run, --list flags, parallel dispatch, and trends subcommand. Skill has richer frontmatter (tags, author, repository, license). Code quality across all agents and skills is excellent: clear section numbering, precise instructions, comprehensive edge cases.
development.recommendation: Consider removing the legacy commands/sentinel.md since skills/sentinel/SKILL.md is the primary entry point and has richer metadata. Or document the dual-path strategy explicitly.
development.riskIfIgnored: Two files that must stay in sync is a maintenance burden, though CI mirror parity checks mitigate this.

architecture.topFinding: Clean orchestrator pattern with stateless agents. Run-scoped output directories prevent collisions. Parallel dispatch of sweepers. Plugin structure follows Claude Code conventions. Version consistency now enforced across all 12 files by CI.
architecture.recommendation: Architecture is solid for v1 scope. For v2 multi-framework support, plan an extensible manifest-generator architecture (strategy pattern per framework) before adding React/Express parsers.
architecture.riskIfIgnored: Adding v2 framework support ad-hoc could lead to a monolithic manifest-generator agent. Designing the extension point now is cheaper than refactoring later.

product.topFinding: Well-defined v1 scope fully implemented: Vue 3 + FastAPI, endpoint health, RBAC, CRUD flows, schema validation, responsive testing, i18n detection. Sweep history tracking adds trend analysis capability. Clear v2 roadmap in README.
product.recommendation: Add acceptance criteria for v2 framework support items. The roadmap lists React, Express, Django etc. but without testable success criteria.
product.riskIfIgnored: v2 scope remains informal bullet points without measurable definition of done.

api.topFinding: Well-defined JSON schemas for findings, manifest, and settings. Consistent contract between orchestrator and agents. test-manifest-schema.sh validates manifest structure programmatically. Parameter resolution system (lookup/static/env) is well-specified.
api.recommendation: Add formal JSON Schema files (.schema.json) for manifest, findings, and settings. The test suite already validates structure but formal schemas enable IDE autocompletion and third-party tooling.
api.riskIfIgnored: Schema contracts exist only in prose and shell test assertions. No programmatic validation beyond the test suite.

monitoring.topFinding: Sweep history tracking added via sweep-history.json — tracks run metadata, finding counts, pass rates across sweeps. /sentinel trends subcommand visualizes pass-rate trends, finding counts by severity, and issue deltas between consecutive runs.
monitoring.recommendation: Add a warning threshold to trends — if pass rate drops more than 10% between runs, print a prominent warning. Currently trends are informational only.
monitoring.riskIfIgnored: Degradation trends are visible but not flagged automatically. A gradual decline could go unnoticed without explicit alerting.

performance.topFinding: Parallel dispatch of browser and API sweepers. Appropriate model selection (Opus for deep analysis, Sonnet for throughput). Configurable timeouts. No performance concerns at current scale.
performance.recommendation: No performance concerns at current scale. Consider caching manifest generation results to avoid re-analyzing unchanged files when v2 adds more framework parsers.

documentation.topFinding: Exceptional documentation. README covers installation, usage, configuration, architecture, troubleshooting. CLAUDE.md provides full AI context. CHANGELOG follows Keep a Changelog. Design spec and implementation plan in docs/. Sweep history spec added.
documentation.recommendation: Add a CONTRIBUTING.md for external contributors. The development guidelines exist in CLAUDE.md but a dedicated file would be more discoverable.
documentation.riskIfIgnored: Contributors must read CLAUDE.md to find development guidelines, which is unconventional.

specifications.topFinding: Outstanding specification quality. Design spec, implementation plan, and sweep history spec in docs/. Agent instructions include exact JSON schemas, step-by-step procedures, edge case handling. Risk scoring formula is precisely defined with modifiers.
specifications.recommendation: Add acceptance criteria for v2 roadmap items (React Router, Express, Django, session auth, OpenAPI import).
specifications.riskIfIgnored: v2 scope remains informal without testable criteria.

projectDocs.topFinding: Design spec documents architectural decisions (orchestrator pattern, risk scoring, run-scoped directories). CHANGELOG tracks per-version decisions. Key design decisions section in CLAUDE.md. However, no formal ADRs.
projectDocs.recommendation: Add a decisions section to CLAUDE.md summarizing key choices. The design spec serves as the de facto ADR but is buried in docs/.
projectDocs.riskIfIgnored: Minor — design spec already covers this, just not prominently surfaced.

progress.topFinding: CHANGELOG clearly documents what changed in v1.1.0. Git history is clean with descriptive commit messages. CI validates structural integrity on every push. However, implementation plan in docs/ still does not mark completed tasks.
progress.recommendation: Mark completed tasks in docs/2026-03-15-sentinel-plan.md. Add file path pointers for each task so a new agent can navigate directly to relevant code.
progress.riskIfIgnored: A new contributor must cross-reference git history to determine completion status. Manageable but friction-adding.
